policy: Curated link-only catalog. Verify code, exact runtime versions, licenses, external API terms, and authentication independently. Entries sourced from gishub.org/software are credited to Dr. Qiusheng Wu's directory; no upstream code is bundled. Esri PE is factory metadata, not proprietary engine code; SpatialReference.org is an independent PROJ-generated authority resource. Preserve official Esri UI folder terminology but do not invent unexported folder paths.
